baseline.description: Moderate prompt and moderate generation; sanity workload for latency and throughput.

prefill-heavy.description: Long prompt with short generation; stresses prompt processing and KV-cache creation.

very-prefill-heavy.description: Very long prompt with medium generation; intended to expose long-prefill queueing and memory pressure.

decode-heavy.description: Short prompt with long generation; stresses autoregressive decode.
